STEP 7 - Energy: Roasted potato, cooked, about 110 kcal per 100 g (with some oil absorbed from roasting, I'll use 130 kcal/100 g). 140 g x 1.3 = 182 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Six potato chunks on a side plate is a modest side portion; 140 g and about 180 kcal is plausible.
